Jaka nawierzchnia jest najlepsza na bois: Which surface is best for a court?
Nie ma jednej najlepszej. Do piłki zwykl: There is no single best surface. Football typically uses artificial turf or EPDM; basketball, volleyball and multi-use courts use EPDM or acrylic; rubber tiles or mats suit areas requiring impact attenuation; and sports coatings can refresh old concrete. I start with the sport, substrate and intended use.

To grupa systemów z materiałów syntetycz: A group of systems made from synthetic materials. For courts, the term usually refers to polyurethane (EPDM) or acrylic systems; artificial turf is compared separately. Systems differ in elasticity, installation, substrate requirements and maintenance.
